metadata.description: Audit → approve → refresh. Diagnose content decay with SE Ranking data (plus optional real Search Console ground truth) and generate surgical, fact-checked update drafts. No databases, no channels — chat and plain files.

plugins.name: content-refresh
plugins.description: Two skills: refresh-audit (find decayed pages, diagnose why, propose the lightest fix, get approval in chat) and refresh-update (write the approved refreshes, fact-checked, as markdown drafts). Requires the SE Ranking and Firecrawl connectors; a Google Search Console connector is optional and adds real click/impression ground truth when present.
